name: door_design_a
prompt: Image 1 is a top-down X-ray style floor plan detail of a doorway in the thick front wall of a prison hall: a vestibule on the left, the hall on the right, the wall running vertically between them. Keep the same strict 90-degree top-down view, the same framing, the same floor textures, the same wall thickness and position, and the same cold cyan X-ray rendering with glowing edges on the tops of the walls. Replace ONLY the door frame around the opening with a new design, and draw the door CLOSED across the opening. The opening stays exactly where it is and exactly as wide. Design: a single heavy steel sliding slab door, about as thick as the wall. On the upper side of the opening the wall widens into a long box-shaped steel housing with a dark slot in it, long enough to swallow the whole slab when it slides open. On the lower side a short steel receiving post. Rivets, ribs across the slab, two yellow locking bars. No people, no text, no labels, no arrows, no UI.
